desc: Full body pixel art sprite: the same character as the head references, drawn on the headless body reference. A short muscular adult dragon-wolf man in a cute and cool anime furry style, three-quarter view facing left, standing idle with one hand raised. Head exactly like the references: big round smooth snout tip bulging forward with no nostrils, short jaw, half-lidded sly eyes with a thick dark upper eyelid and light blue iris, small white fang, light blue tongue sticking out a little, big spiky hair tufts and bangs over the forehead, big pointed ears with light blue insides and silver bar piercings, two thick flat light blue crystal horns with diagonal facet lines (front one larger), two small white studs on the forehead, dark collar with a silver ring. Purple-tinted charcoal grey fur, mid grey, lighter than black. Big fluffy tail. No clothing: smooth simple body like a mannequin, no anatomical details. Clean dark outline, simple soft shading. Plain flat light grey background, nothing else.
